books.title: Psychology 101
books.author: Dr. Sarah Mitchell
books.description: A comprehensive introduction to the fundamentals of psychology, covering key concepts, theories, and applications in everyday life.

books.title: Atomic Habits
books.author: James Clear
books.description: An easy and proven way to build good habits and break bad ones. Learn how tiny changes can lead to remarkable results.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.description: Explore the two systems that drive the way we think: System 1 is fast, intuitive, and emotional; System 2 is slower, more deliberative, and more logical.

books.title: Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.description: Explore how Homo sapiens came to dominate the world, from the Stone Age to the present day, examining cognitive, agricultural, and scientific revolutions.

books.title: The Lean Startup
books.author: Eric Ries
books.description: How today's entrepreneurs use continuous innovation to create radically successful businesses. Learn about validated learning and the build-measure-learn cycle.

books.title: Deep Work
books.author: Cal Newport
books.description: Rules for focused success in a distracted world. Learn how to cultivate deep work to master hard things quickly and produce elite-level output.
